name: Accordion
description: Collapsible sections. Items as [{title, content}]. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'.

name: ActivityItem
description: Quiet activity/check row — icon · title · optional trailing status. Default variant is pill.

name: ActivityList
description: Stack of Codex-style pill rows. Bind items via $state to an array.

name: Alert
description: Alert banner

name: Avatar
description: User avatar with fallback initials

name: Badge
description: Status badge with AOS color palette.

name: Box
description: Generic container — use className for full Tailwind control.

name: Button
description: AOS button (shadcn variants). primary→default, danger→destructive.

name: ButtonGroup
description: Segmented button group. Use { $bindState } on selected for selected value.

name: Card
description: Container card for content sections. Children render inside CardContent.

name: Carousel
description: Horizontally scrollable carousel of cards.

name: Checkbox
description: Checkbox input. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

name: Collapsible
description: Collapsible section with trigger. Children render inside.

name: DetailSection
description: Linear-style collapsible detail section (chevron + quiet title).

name: Dialog
description: Modal dialog. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.

name: DiffStats
description: Colored +/− diff counter (same styling as the Changes panel).

name: DiffView
description: Full text diff viewer using @pierre/diffs (same engine as Changes panel).

name: Drawer
description: Bottom sheet drawer. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.

name: DropdownMenu
description: Dropdown menu with trigger button and selectable items. Use { $bindState } on value for selected item binding.

name: Grid
description: Grid layout (1-6 columns)

name: Heading
description: Heading text (h1-h4)

name: Icon
description: Dynamic Lucide icon resolved by name.

name.description: Lucide icon name in PascalCase, e.g. GitBranch

name: Image
description: Image component. Renders an img tag when src is provided, otherwise a placeholder.

name: Input
description: Text input with AOS styling.

name: Link
description: Anchor link. Bind on.press for click handler.

name: MarkdownContent
description: Renders markdown with AOS MarkdownContent (tasks/chat parity). Bind content via $state, e.g. { $state: '/items/0/body' }.

name: Pagination
description: Page navigation. Use { $bindState } on page for current page number.

name: Popover
description: Popover that appears on click of trigger.

name: Progress
description: Progress bar (value 0-100)

name: Radio
description: Radio button group. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

name: ScrollArea
description: Scrollable region for sidebars and long content.

name: SearchInput
description: Sidebar search field (SplitPageLayout.SearchInput styling). Use { $bindState } on value.

name: Select
description: Dropdown select input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

name: Separator
description: Visual separator line

name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder skeleton

name: Slider
description: Range slider input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

name: Spinner
description: Loading spinner indicator

name: SplitPageContent
description: Main content / detail column inside SplitPageLayout.

name: SplitPageContentBody
description: Scrollable detail body inside SplitPageContent.

name: SplitPageContentHeader
description: Detail header toolbar (title row + actions).

name: SplitPageLayout
description: Master-detail page shell (sidebar + content). Children: SplitPageSidebar + SplitPageContent.

name: SplitPageSidebar
description: Left sidebar column inside SplitPageLayout.

name: SplitPageSidebarContent
description: Scrollable list area inside the sidebar.

name: SplitPageSidebarHeader
description: Sticky header row inside the sidebar (search, tabs, actions).

name: SplitPageSidebarItem
description: Selectable sidebar row with title, meta, optional badge and diff stats.

name: Stack
description: Flex container for layouts

name: Stat
description: Metadata display — inline, tile, strip KPI cell, or Codex-style labeled row.

name: Switch
description: Toggle switch. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

name: Table
description: Data table. columns: header labels. rows: 2D array of cell strings, e.g. [["Alice","admin"],["Bob","user"]].

name: Tabs
description: Tab navigation. Use { $bindState } on value for active tab binding.

name: TabsSubtle
description: AOS subtle tabs (animated pill). Use { $bindState } on value for active tab.

count.description: Optional count shown beside the tab (works with activeLabel)

name: Text
description: Paragraph text with AOS typography tokens.

name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: blur).

name: Toggle
description: Toggle button. Use { $bindState } on pressed for state binding.

name: ToggleGroup
description: Group of toggle buttons. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'. Use { $bindState } on value.

name: Tooltip
description: Hover tooltip. Shows content on hover over text.
